title: CONNECT-UDP HTTP/1.1 Upgrade Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9298 HTTP/1.1 upgrade policy.
scope: This verification covers the HTTP/1.1 GET method, single Host field, Connection: Upgrade, Upgrade: connect-udp, malformed 400 recommendation, 101 response, response upgrade fields, no-content Capsule requirements, failed-attempt abort decision, and required HTTP setting marker.
preconditions: RFC 9298 request target and Capsule Protocol policy helpers are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused HTTP/1.1 upgrade policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 HTTP/1.1 artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 HTTP/1.1 upgrade policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Live connection upgrade I/O and UDP forwarding remain future adapter work.
